generatedFor.zh: enGo 3.6.2（文字說明）；多數截圖取自 3.2.2（建置 489）

note.zh: 截圖取自「模型屋」示範住家與智管家實驗社區帳號，多數於 enGo 3.2.2（建置 489）正式建置實機擷取；庫存管理頁取自 SmartPad（enGo 3.6.0）實機，通知頁為較新的平板實機重拍。僅裁切、未修圖。
note.en: Screenshots were captured on the Model Home demo household and the enGo test-community account, most of them on the enGo 3.2.2 (build 489) release build; the inventory pages come from a SmartPad running enGo 3.6.0, and the notifications page is a newer tablet capture. Cropped only, never retouched.

summary.zh: 建立住家、填好地址與社區、規劃房間，並把家人加進來。這是所有其他功能的基礎。房間名稱之後會直接成為語音指令的一部分。
summary.en: Create a household, fill in its address and community, plan the rooms, and invite your family. Everything else builds on this. Room names later become part of your voice commands.

body.zh: 點首頁左上的住家名稱展開清單。目前使用中的住家左側有勾號。清單下方有「創建家庭」與「加入一個新家庭」（用邀請碼加入別人的住家）。一個帳號可以管理多個住家，切換後首頁、工單、公告都會跟著換。
body.en: Tap the household name at the top left of the home screen. A check mark shows which one is active. Below the list are Create household and Join a household (using an invite code). One account can manage several households; switching also switches the home screen, work orders and announcements.

body.zh: 在住家清單中點該住家右側的鉛筆進入「家庭管理」。依序填家庭名稱、縣市、區鎮、街道（可按右側定位圖示自動帶入）、所在社區、門牌號。改完務必按右上角「保存」。
body.en: In the household list, tap the pencil on the right to open Household management. Fill in the name, city, district, street (the pin icon can locate it for you), community and unit number. Always press Save at the top right.

body.zh: 同一頁往下捲就是房間清單。在輸入框輸入名稱後按「＋」新增；每一列右側可改名（鉛筆）或刪除（垃圾桶）。建議依實際格局建立：客廳、主臥、次臥、廚房、浴室、陽台。
body.en: Scroll down the same page for the room list. Type a name and press + to add; each row can be renamed (pencil) or deleted (trash). Use your real layout: living room, master bedroom, second bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, balcony.

body.zh: 再往下是權限資訊與成員資訊。成員可用信箱或電話邀請，角色分所有者／管理員／成員。權限資訊會逐項列出該角色能做什麼：設備、一鍵執行、自動化、管理成員、管理家庭。
body.en: Further down are Permissions and Members. Invite members by email or phone; roles are Owner, Admin and Member. The permissions panel lists exactly what the role can do: devices, one-tap scenes, automations, managing members, managing the household.

tips.zh: 房間名稱請用家人自己的說法（「主臥」而不是「房間 1」）。這個名稱會直接被語音使用，好不好念決定語音好不好用。
tips.en: Name rooms the way your family actually says them ("master bedroom", not "room 1"). The name becomes part of the voice command, so how easily it is spoken decides how well voice works.

tips.zh: 🔒 邀請碼請當成密碼看待。任何人拿到就能加入您的住家、看到並控制家中裝置。不要拍照外流或貼在群組；若已外流，按邀請碼右側的重新產生鍵即可讓舊碼失效。
tips.en: 🔒 Treat the invite code like a password. Anyone who has it can join your household and control your devices. Never share it in a photo or a group chat; if it leaks, press Regenerate next to the code to invalidate the old one.

summary.zh: 配網是讓裝置連上您家 Wi-Fi 並加入 enGo 的過程。首頁右上「＋」進入「添加設備」，上方有六種方式，先試「設備發現」。
summary.en: Pairing is how a device joins your Wi-Fi and your enGo home. Tap + at the top right of the home screen to open Add device. Six methods are offered: try Device discovery first.

body.zh: ① 平板或手機連在 2.4GHz Wi-Fi（多數智慧裝置不支援 5GHz，這是最常見的失敗原因）② 裝置已進入配對模式（多為長按重置鍵至指示燈快閃，做法依廠牌而異）③ 裝置與路由器距離不要太遠。
body.en: ① Your tablet or phone is on 2.4GHz Wi-Fi (most smart devices do not support 5GHz, this is the most common cause of failure). ② The device is in pairing mode (usually hold its reset button until the LED blinks fast; this varies by brand). ③ The device is not too far from the router.

body.zh: 適用大多數 Wi-Fi 裝置。讓裝置進入配對模式，畫面會自動列出找到的裝置，選取後指定房間即可。若等約 30 秒仍沒有任何裝置出現，這一頁不會主動告訴您失敗。請改用下面其他方式，或回頭確認上一步的三個條件。
body.en: Works for most Wi-Fi devices. Put the device in pairing mode and it appears in the list; select it and assign a room. If nothing appears after about 30 seconds the page will not tell you it failed. Switch to one of the methods below, or re-check the three conditions above.

title.zh: 子設備配網（透過閘道器）

body.zh: ZigBee 等裝置需要透過閘道器加入。先確認閘道器已加入且在線，選擇網關設備後按「開始配網」，再讓子裝置進入配網模式。
body.en: ZigBee and similar devices join through a gateway. Make sure the gateway is already added and online, choose it, press Start pairing, then put the sub-device into pairing mode.

body.zh: 支援 Matter 標準的裝置。先設定 WiFi，再輸入或掃碼取得裝置的配網碼，然後按「開始配網」。
body.en: For devices that support the Matter standard. Set the Wi-Fi first, then type or scan the device's pairing code, and press Start pairing.

body.zh: 包裝或機身有 enGo QR 碼的裝置。先設定 WiFi，按「生成二維碼」後以裝置掃描該碼完成配網。
body.en: For devices with an enGo QR code on the box or body. Set the Wi-Fi, press Generate QR code, and let the device scan it.

title.zh: AP 配網（生態系裝置，備援）

body.zh: 適用生態系裝置，上述方式都失敗時使用，共三個步驟。步驟 1：長按裝置配網鍵 3-5 秒，待指示燈快閃、裝置自行開啟 AP 熱點；步驟 2：手動連上該熱點；步驟 3：回到 App 完成。配網進行中，畫面會顯示五個節點的進程點線圖：取得配網資訊 → 傳送資訊給設備 → 等待設備連網 → 等待設備上線 → 配網完成，卡在哪一步就知道問題出在哪一段。
body.en: For ecosystem devices; use it when the others fail. It has three steps. Step 1: hold the device's pairing button for 3-5 seconds until the LED blinks fast and the device opens its own hotspot. Step 2: connect to that hotspot manually. Step 3: return to the app to finish. While pairing runs, a five-node progress line is shown: get pairing info → send info to the device → wait for the device to join the network → wait for the device to come online → pairing complete. Where it stalls tells you which stage is at fault.

title.zh: ESP 配網（enGo 自有裝置）

body.zh: 485 轉換器等 enGo 自有裝置使用。同為熱點方式，但走 enGo 自己的配網流程，上線與否改由後端確認。
body.en: For enGo's own devices such as the 485 converter. It is also a hotspot method, but follows enGo's own pairing flow, and whether the device is online is confirmed by the backend.

tips.zh: 配網成功後請立刻改名並指定房間。「白色四鍵123」這種型號名在語音與情境裡都不好用，改成「客廳壁切」才有意義。
tips.en: Rename the device and assign its room right away. A model name like "white 4-gang 123" is useless in voice commands and scenes, "living-room wall switch" is not.

tips.zh: 同一台裝置重複配網會建立第二筆紀錄。配網前先確認它是不是已經在清單裡。
tips.en: Pairing the same device twice creates a second entry. Check the list before pairing again.

tips.zh: 3.6.x 起「AP 配網」與「ESP 配網」是兩個分頁。選錯分頁不會有明確錯誤訊息，只會一直停在等待。認不出裝置是哪一種時，請洽安裝人員。
tips.en: From 3.6.x, AP pairing and ESP pairing are two separate tabs. Choosing the wrong one gives no clear error, it just waits forever. If you cannot tell which kind your device is, ask your installer.

summary.zh: 情境把多個動作打包成一鍵。分手動執行（您主動點或用語音喊）與自動執行（由條件觸發）。情境名稱會直接被語音使用，所以取名很重要。
summary.en: A scene bundles several actions into one tap. Manual scenes you trigger yourself (by tap or by voice); automatic scenes fire on a condition. The scene name becomes the voice command, so naming matters.

body.zh: 自動執行：由條件自動觸發，右側開關可啟用／停用。手動執行：需要您主動執行，語音可以直接執行這一類。執行紀錄：查看過去的執行情形。
body.en: Automatic: fires on a condition; the switch on the right enables or disables it. Manual: you trigger it yourself, and voice can run these directly. History: shows past runs.

body.zh: 情境頁右上「＋」開始建立。第一個畫面決定這是手動還是自動：「選擇控制設備」＝手動；「設備狀態變化時」與「定時」＝自動。
body.en: Press + at the top right of the Scenes page. The first screen decides manual or automatic: Choose devices to control = manual; When a device's state changes and Schedule = automatic.

title.en: Steps 2-3: pick devices and set actions

body.zh: 依房間分頁挑選裝置，然後勾選要下達的項目。這一層顯示的是裝置本身回報的控制項名稱（例如「開關1」），不是 enGo 另外取的名字，因此會依裝置廠牌而異。
body.en: Pick a device from the room tabs, then tick the items to send. This level shows the control names the device itself reports (e.g. "switch 1") rather than names enGo assigns, so they vary by brand.

title.zh: 步驟 4：命名並確認任務清單
title.en: Step 4: name it and review the task list

body.zh: 輸入情境名稱，下方表格逐列列出已加入的任務：房間、裝置、任務名稱、任務內容、在線狀態。可按「添加任務」再加一台裝置。
body.en: Enter the scene name. The table below lists every task you have added: room, device, task name, task value and online state. Press Add task to include another device.

body.zh: 按右上「保存」。存檔後回到情境頁，於對應分頁出現新卡片。若卡片顯示「狀態讀取失敗」，按右上重整鍵即可。那是新情境還沒取到裝置狀態，不是設定錯誤。
body.en: Press Save at the top right. You return to the Scenes page and the new card appears under the matching tab. If the card says the status could not be read, press the refresh icon. The new scene simply has not fetched device states yet; nothing is wrong with your settings.

body.zh: 卡片右上「⋯」有三個選項：延時執行（過一段時間後才執行）、編輯、移除。自動情境的卡片右側另有開關，可暫時停用而不刪除，例如出遠門時先關掉自動亮燈。
body.en: The ⋯ menu on each card offers three options: Run later, Edit and Remove. Automatic scenes also have a switch on the right so you can pause one without deleting it, handy when you travel and want the auto lights off.

tips.zh: 「下班模式」比「情境 A」好記也好念。避免兩個情境取相近的名字，否則語音會反問您指的是哪一個。
tips.en: "Leaving-work mode" beats "Scene A", easier to remember and to say. Avoid near-identical names, or voice will ask which one you meant.

tips.zh: ⚠ 兩個情境同名時，移除的確認視窗只會顯示名稱、不會顯示是哪一個。清單裡有同名情境時，建議先用「編輯」確認內容，或先改名再刪。
tips.en: ⚠ If two scenes share a name, the delete confirmation shows only the name, not which one. Use Edit to confirm the contents first, or rename before deleting.

summary.zh: 首頁是最常用的一頁：上方是住家名稱與天氣，中段是房間分頁，下方依房間分組列出裝置卡片，每張卡片顯示名稱與在線狀態。
summary.en: The home screen is the one you use most: household name and weather on top, room tabs in the middle, then device cards grouped by room, each showing its name and online state.

body.zh: 點上方的房間分頁只看該房間的裝置，或用右側放大鏡直接搜尋名稱。卡片上的綠點代表在線、紅點代表離線。
body.en: Tap a room tab to see only that room's devices, or use the magnifier on the right to search by name. A green dot means online, red means offline.

body.zh: 剛配網還沒指定房間的裝置會落在「未分配」。建議盡快把它們歸進房間。未分配的裝置語音叫不到。
body.en: Devices paired but not yet assigned a room land in Unassigned. Move them into rooms promptly. Unassigned devices cannot be reached by voice.

title.zh: 右上四個按鈕（平板版面）
title.en: The four buttons at the top right (tablet layout)

body.zh: 平板首頁右上角的四個圖示，依序為版面切換、設備數據、手動更新、新增裝置。手機沒有這四顆按鈕，右上角是一個 ☰ 選單。改過裝置或情境而畫面還沒跟上時，按手動更新最快。
body.en: On the tablet layout, the four icons at the top right are, from left to right: layout switch, device data, manual refresh and add device. The phone does not show these four buttons; it has a single ☰ menu at the top right instead. If you changed a device or scene and the screen has not caught up, manual refresh is the quickest fix.

title.zh: 點卡片進入裝置控制頁
title.en: Tap a card to open the device page

body.zh: 點任一張裝置卡片就進入該裝置的控制頁。每一種裝置的控制頁長得不一樣：版面由裝置本身支援的功能決定，常見有即時資訊、開關、檔位／模式、轉盤或滑桿，右上齒輪則是改名與換房間。即時資訊顯示「--」多半是裝置關機或尚未回報，不是故障。
body.en: Tap any device card to open its control page. Every device type looks different, the layout follows what the device actually supports: live readings, switches, presets/modes, dials or sliders, with the gear at the top right for renaming and moving rooms. A reading showing “--” usually means the device is off or has not reported yet, not that it is broken.

tips.zh: 裝置顯示離線時，先看它自己的指示燈與電源，再看家中 Wi-Fi，最後才懷疑 App。
tips.en: If a device shows offline, check its own LED and power first, then your Wi-Fi, and only then suspect the app.

tips.zh: 平板左側導覽列依序為家庭、場景、工單、庫存、預約、通知、訊息、設置、登出，可用最上方的「收起／展開」切換成只有圖示。
tips.en: On the tablet the left navigation rail lists 家庭 Home, 場景 Scenes, 工單 Work orders, 庫存 Inventory, 預約 Reservations, 通知 Notifications, 訊息 Messages, 設置 Settings and 登出 Sign out. The top Collapse/Expand button shrinks it to icons only.

summary.zh: 設備數據把裝置自己回報的量測值整理成四個分頁：用電趨勢、用電分布、用水量、空氣品質。用途是看趨勢與占比，哪一台耗電、什麼時段耗電，不是台電計費依據。
summary.en: Device Data organises the readings your devices report into four tabs: energy trend, energy breakdown, water usage and air quality. It is for spotting trends and shares, which device draws power, and when, not for utility billing.

body.zh: 平板：首頁右上角的第二顆圖示（數據報表）。手機：從裝置頁進入。進去之後共有用電趨勢、用電分布、用水量、空氣品質四個分頁。
body.en: Tablet: the second icon at the top right of the home screen (the data-report button). Phone: open it from the device page. Inside there are four tabs: energy trend, energy breakdown, water usage and air quality.

title.zh: 用電趨勢：看什麼時段在耗電
title.en: Energy trend: when power is being drawn

body.zh: 四張數值卡分別是日最高、日最低、累計與平均每日用電（單位：度），下方長條圖以小時為刻度。上方可切換要看的裝置，以及日／月／年與日期。
body.en: Four cards show the daily high, daily low, cumulative and average daily consumption (in kWh), with an hourly bar chart below. Above them you can switch device, day/month/year and the date.

title.zh: 用電分布：看哪一台在耗電
title.en: Energy breakdown: which device draws it

body.zh: 環圈圖顯示總用電量，下方逐台列出度數與百分比。想找「電費是誰用掉的」就看這一頁。
body.en: A donut chart shows total consumption, with each device's kWh and share listed below. This is the page for answering “what is using the electricity”.

title.zh: 用水量：需搭配淨水設備

body.zh: 四張數值卡為月最高、月最低、累計與平均每日水量（單位：L），長條圖以日為刻度。家中沒有淨水器或智慧主閥時這一頁不會有數字。
body.en: Four cards show the monthly high, monthly low, cumulative and average daily water volume (in litres), with a daily bar chart. Without a water purifier or smart main valve this tab stays empty.

title.zh: 空氣品質：需搭配感測裝置

body.zh: 以折線圖呈現，可切換 PM2.5 等指標與日／月／年。同樣地，家中沒有空氣品質感測裝置時這一頁不會有數字。
body.en: Shown as a line chart; you can switch the metric (PM2.5 and others) and day/month/year. Again, without an air-quality sensor this tab stays empty.

tips.zh: 這裡的度數來自裝置自己回報的量測值，和台電電表不會完全一致。它回答的是「哪一台、什麼時候」，不是「這個月要繳多少」。
tips.en: These readings come from the devices themselves and will not match your utility meter exactly. They answer “which device, and when”, not “how much is this month's bill”.

tips.zh: 某個分頁一直沒有數字，通常不是故障，而是家中沒有對應的裝置（用水量要淨水設備、空氣品質要感測器）。
tips.en: A tab with no numbers is usually not a fault: it means you do not have the matching hardware (water needs water equipment, air quality needs a sensor).

summary.zh: 主題、語系、個人資料、裝置告警門檻，以及回報問題時要提供的版本號都在這裡。
summary.en: Theme, language, personal details, device alarm thresholds, and the version numbers to quote when reporting a problem.

title.en: What is on the Settings page

body.zh: 目前主題（淺色／深色）、目前語系（預設跟隨系統）、個人信息、設備告警設置、當前版本、後端版本、會員條款、帳號註銷。
body.en: Theme (light/dark), language (follows the system by default), personal information, device alarm settings, app version, backend version, terms of membership, and account deletion.

title.zh: 回報問題時請附兩組版本號
title.en: Quote both version numbers when reporting an issue

body.zh: 「當前版本」是 App 版本，「後端版本」是雲端服務版本。兩組一起提供，客服才能判斷問題出在哪一端。
body.en: App version and backend version. Provide both so support can tell which side the problem is on.

body.zh: 「帳號註銷」是刪除帳號的入口，在設定頁申請。是否有可取消的緩衝期，請洽客服確認。若只是想換手機或重新登入，不需要用這個功能。
body.en: “Account deletion” (帳號註銷) in Settings is where you request deleting your account. Whether there is a grace period in which it can be cancelled, please confirm with customer service. If you only want to change phones or sign in again, you do not need this.

tips.zh: 手機上叫「設置」不叫「設定」，同樣在底部「更多」分頁裡。手機沒有左側導覽列，底部只有家庭、場景、工單、通知、更多五個分頁，其餘功能都收在「更多」。
tips.en: On phones it is labelled 設置 rather than 設定, also under the bottom “More” tab. Phones have no left-hand nav: the bottom bar carries only Home, Scenes, Work Orders, Notifications and More, and everything else sits under More.

tips.zh: 裝置告警門檻（例如溫濕度上下限）設得太敏感會一直推播；建議先用預設值住一週再調。
tips.en: Alarm thresholds that are too sensitive will keep pushing notifications. Live with the defaults for a week before tuning them.

summary.zh: 通知頁收電鈴、信箱、包裹三類通知；訊息收系統、社區與商城三類消息，社區公告也在訊息裡看。這是 enGo 與一般智慧家庭產品最大的差別。不必為了看社區公告另外裝一支 App。
summary.en: The Notifications page carries doorbell, mailbox and parcel notices; Messages holds system, community and shop messages, and community announcements are read there too. This is what sets enGo apart from ordinary smart-home products. You do not need a second app to read community notices.

body.zh: 平板：左側導覽列的鈴鐺圖示；手機：底部第四個分頁「通知」。上方三個分頁分別是電鈴通知（有人按門口電鈴的來電紀錄）、信箱通知（信件到達）、包裹通知（有您的包裹到管理室）。分頁下方另有查看攝影機、解鎖開門、致電管理中心三個按鈕，解鎖開門的使用範圍請洽專人。圖中社區目前沒有電鈴紀錄，所以顯示「尚無資料」。
body.en: Tablet: the bell icon in the left rail. Phone: the fourth tab at the bottom, 通知 (Notifications). The three tabs at the top are doorbell notices (a log of calls when someone rings at the door), mailbox notices (mail has arrived) and parcel notices (a parcel for you has reached the management office). Below the tabs are three buttons: view camera, unlock door and call the management center; please ask our team about the scope of unlock door. In this screenshot the community has no doorbell records yet, so it shows 尚無資料 (No data).

body.zh: 公告在訊息裡：平板是左側導覽列的對話框圖示，手機在底部「更多」裡的「訊息」。點進任一則可看完整全文。公告與您的所在社區綁定，沒有收到任何公告時，先確認家庭管理的社區設定是否正確。
body.en: Announcements live under Messages: the speech-bubble icon in the tablet's left rail, or 訊息 under More on the phone. Open any item for the full text. Announcements are tied to your community, so if none arrive, first check the community setting in Home management.

body.zh: 系統消息（維護、版本）、社區／大樓消息（管理費、包裹、公告）、商城消息（優惠、訂單）。可用上方分頁分別檢視。
body.en: System messages (maintenance, releases), community/building messages (management fees, parcels, announcements) and shop messages (offers, orders). Use the tabs at the top to view each.

tips.zh: 包裹通知在通知頁的「包裹通知」分頁，訊息裡也看得到；若沒收到，先確認設定裡的通知權限。
tips.en: Parcel notices sit in the Parcel tab of the Notifications page and also appear under Messages. If you are not getting them, check notification permission in Settings first.

tips.zh: 包裹怎麼領（3.6.x 起）：智能櫃走到櫃前，在 App 按「開櫃取件」，櫃門自動開啟，不需輸入取件碼；人工櫃或管理室則前往存放位置向管理中心取件。
tips.en: Collecting a parcel (from 3.6.x): at a smart locker, walk up to it and tap “Open locker” in the app; the door opens by itself and no pickup code needs to be typed in. For a staffed locker or the management office, collect it from the management center.

summary.zh: 住家或公設有問題可直接在 App 提出報修，並追蹤處理進度。
summary.en: Report a problem at home or in the shared facilities straight from the app, then follow its progress.

body.zh: 左側欄的工單（扳手圖示；手機在底部「工單」分頁），右上「＋」新增。填寫維修項目與描述，可附照片。送出後系統產生工單編號。
body.en: Work orders (工單) in the left rail, the wrench icon (on the phone, the bottom 工單 tab), then + at the top right. Describe the item and the problem, and attach photos. Submitting creates a work-order number.

body.zh: 工單列表顯示編號、維修項目、狀態與建立時間，右側可查看詳情。狀態變更會推播通知。
body.en: The list shows the number, item, status and creation time, with details on the right. Status changes are pushed to you.

tips.zh: 附一張照片通常能省掉一次來回確認。
tips.en: One photo usually saves a round trip of questions.

summary.zh: 健身房、會議室、交誼廳等公設可直接在 App 預約，並查詢或取消既有預約。
summary.en: Book the gym, meeting room, lounge and other shared facilities in the app, and review or cancel existing bookings.

body.zh: 可預約項目頁以卡片列出設施名稱、位置、總人數限制與費率。
body.en: The facilities page lists each one as a card with its name, location, capacity and rate.

body.zh: 點進設施看項目資訊、說明、規格與注意事項，右側填預約日期、開始與結束時間、成人與兒童人數，送出即完成。
body.en: Open a facility to see its information, description, specifications and rules; on the right choose the date, start and end time, and the number of adults and children, then submit.

body.zh: 預約紀錄分頁列出過去與未來的預約，可在規定時限內取消。
body.en: The history tab lists past and upcoming bookings; you can cancel within the allowed window.

tips.zh: 取消時限依各社區規章而異，請看該設施的「注意事項&限制」分頁。
tips.en: Cancellation windows differ by community: check the facility's rules tab.

summary.zh: 記錄家中物品放在哪個房間的哪個櫃位、還有多少，並在低於告警門檻時提醒。適合濾芯、電池、備品這類「要用時常常找不到」的東西。
summary.en: Track which room and cabinet each item is in and how many are left, with a reminder when stock falls below your alert threshold. Ideal for filters, batteries and spares, the things you can never find when you need them.

body.zh: 庫存頁上方有物品、櫃位、分類、記錄、告警五個分頁。先在「櫃位」建立實體收納位置（例如「廚房下櫃」），在「分類」建立類別（例如「濾芯」），再回到「物品」新增。
body.en: The inventory page has five tabs: Items, Cabinets, Categories, History and Alerts. Create your physical storage places under Cabinets (e.g. "kitchen lower cabinet") and your categories (e.g. "filters") first, then add items.

body.zh: 上方四個數字是物品總數、櫃位總數、分類總數與低庫存數量。可用房間分頁篩選，或用右上放大鏡搜尋。
body.en: The four figures on top are total items, cabinets, categories and low-stock count. Filter by room with the tabs, or search with the magnifier at the top right.

body.zh: 物品卡片可編輯、調整數量、變更位置與查看資訊。「異動位置」對話框會顯示目前存放位置（房間 → 櫃位，例如「會議室 → 設備櫃」）與數量，設定搬移數量後即可改房間或改櫃位。
body.en: Each item card lets you edit it, adjust the quantity, change its location or view details. The move dialog shows the current location (room → cabinet, for example “Meeting room → Equipment cabinet”) and quantity; set how many to move, then choose a new room or cabinet.

tips.zh: 平板與手機都叫「庫存」：平板在左側導覽列，手機收在底部「更多」分頁裡。兩邊是同一頁、同一批資料。（3.2.2 的平板曾顯示「倉儲」，3.6.x 起已統一為「庫存」。）
tips.en: Both the tablet and the phone call this 庫存 (Inventory): on the tablet it is in the left navigation rail, on the phone it sits under the bottom “More” tab. Same page, same data. (Tablets on 3.2.2 showed 倉儲; this was unified to 庫存 in 3.6.x.)

tips.zh: 低庫存門檻在庫存頁的「告警」分頁設定；數量低於門檻的物品，卡片上會出現紅色「庫存不足」標籤，上方的「低庫存」數字就是目前低於門檻的品項數。濾芯這類有壽命的東西，建議一併記下更換日期。
tips.en: Set the low-stock threshold in the Alerts (告警) tab. Any item below it shows a red 庫存不足 (low stock) tag on its card, and the Low stock figure at the top counts those items. For things with a service life, such as filters, record the replacement date too.
